title: A straight line and an oval in a glyph can wear the saved stroke too
goal: Only lines drawn with the Pen can wear a saved stroke today. A glyph that uses the Line tool, or a box or an oval with an outline, keeps its own width, so changing the set's weight misses those parts.
notes: Saved strokes live on PathContent (Sources/PhotonzCore/SavedStrokes.swift). A box and an oval wear their edge as a Border effect (OutlineRetirement.swift) and a line is AnnotationContent, so each needs its own binding. Not a bug in what shipped: the task asks for paths.
acceptance: A Line tool line and an outlined box or oval on an icon can take a saved stroke in one click
Changing the saved stroke's weight moves them with the paths, as one undo step

log.note: Adversarial review before building: a Photoshop/Figma user expects a line style to dress any stroke, so a glyph mixing Pen paths, a Line tool line and an outlined circle must follow one weight change. The mock (icon-draw-wt Stroke section) only draws the path case; no mock covers a line or a box, so the row goes where each one's line is already tuned: a line's Line row in Appearance (same row a path uses) and a box or oval's Border in Effects (the edge lives there since OutlineRetirement). What a box cannot honour: caps (no ends) and corners (its ring's corners come from Corner Radius), so a box wears width and side; a line wears width and caps (straight, no corners, always centred). Chose: a line can be saved from (corners read round, side centre, what a straight line draws), a box cannot (its corners are not a stroke value), so the box's Style row only offers strokes that exist. Risk: a border can also wear a saved effect style; whichever was applied last wins and the other lets go with the usual link-break notice.

Chose the word Stroke for the saved-stroke row on a Border over Style, because that Border already carries a Style row for saved borders and two rows called Style could not be told apart. Pictures in the audit.
Chose to leave arrows out (their weight sizes the head) and to make boxes and ovals wear-only (their ring's corners are the Corner Radius, not a stroke value).

Looked at pictures 1, 2, 4, 6 and 7 of a-line-and-an-oval-wear-the-saved-stroke-walk: the line's Style row reads Glyph / stroke 1.75 under its colour; the oval's Border shows Stroke Glyph / stroke 1.75 with Position Center; at width 3 the path, the line and the oval's ring are the same weight; after one undo all read 1.75. Found the shelf tile's use count lagging (1 use with 3 wearers); the original walk shows it too, so it predates this change: filed a-saved-stroke-tile-on-the-styles-shelf-counts-e.

left rough: an oval or box drawn on an icon arrives with no outline, so it needs the Effects plus before the one click. Asked in the audit's evaluate rather than filed: whether a Border added on an icon should start in the icon's saved stroke the way a Pen outline does is a taste call for the user.

A Line tool line and an outlined box or oval on an icon take the saved stroke in one click (line: Style row under Line; box/oval: Stroke row on its Border), and the saved stroke's width moves them with the paths in one undo step.
